scope: Synthetic text-pipeline scenarios. These do not measure ASR accuracy, audio quality, speaker adaptation, or model training.
notes: Names, situations and sentences are synthetic test fixtures.
Required edits are desired behavior, not a claim that the current model can make every correction.
Keep cases require exact preservation. Any unlisted rewrite counts as a false correction.
Run against a daemon with an isolated empty learning store and no manual context for reproducible results. This evaluator never modifies learning or context state.
